title: Add debit/credit card blocking urgency combo to detect T05

fragment.label_hi: कार्ड विवरण और जल्दबाज़ी का दबाव

rationale: Allows subtle credit/debit card expiry and CVV/PIN harvesting calls (such as missed call T05) to cross the danger alert threshold.
potential_risks: Could raise score on legitimate calls where both card numbers and urgency are simultaneously mentioned.
